items.title: Budhigandaki flood: What the report says about the gap between local warnings and official records
items.blurb: A driver received a flood warning at 4:45am on Sunday and posted an alert on Facebook minutes later, while the disaster authority’s report says a landslide blocked the river at 5:30am.

items.title: Prithvi Highway’s Galaudi section to close overnight for repairs to damaged section
items.blurb: Traffic will be halted from 11pm Monday to 5am Tuesday at Galaudi in Dhading, where a section of the road subsided last week.

items.title: Flood cuts off two villages along Budhigandaki in Gorkha
items.blurb: The river has washed away foot trail connecting Jagat and Salleri, leaving residents, workers and more than 100 trekkers stranded.

items.title: Mud and debris mark the trail of a flash flood in Budhigandaki
items.blurb: Photographs taken on Monday morning show the extent of the flood’s destruction.

items.title: Army helicopter rescues three trapped by landslide in Gorkha
items.blurb: The three were stranded near Ungilung river after a landslide hit the area on Sunday morning and were flown to Philim.

items.title: Flood damage makes journeys longer and costlier in Rasuwa
items.blurb: Many settlements across the district have become inaccessible after the August 26 flood damaged roads and bridges. In Amachhodingmo, dwindling relief supplies are adding to residents’ hardship.

items.title: Locals alerted each other of Budhigandaki flood an hour before official warning
items.blurb: Locals began alerting one another at 4:45 am, but the local police post in Gorkha released the first official warning only at 5:30am.

items.title: Torrent of black mud and rocks engulfs settlements along Budhigandaki
items.blurb: Homes, bridges and trekking trails swept away in Chumnubri. Settlements cut off, tourists stranded, five people missing.

items.title: Bhotekoshi flood wasn’t a freak event. It’s the Himalaya doing what it does
items.blurb: From the 51,000-year-old Tsergo Ri collapse to the 2015 Langtang landslide, rockfalls are part of the Himalayan ecosystem, and global warming is making them more dangerous.

items.title: SMS alerts helped avert loss of life in Budhi Gandaki floods, says disaster management chief
items.blurb: Dharmaraj Uprety says early warnings prompted residents to move to higher ground, while the flood swept away bridges and damaged settlements and hydropower infrastructure.

items.title: ‘It reminded me of the Bhotekoshi floods’: Gorkha residents recount escape
items.blurb: A flash flood in the Budhi Gandaki swept away houses and bridges early Sunday, forcing residents of Chumnubri and Dharche to flee to higher ground in the dark. Five people are missing, and six have been rescued by air.

items.title: Five things to know about the Budhi Gandaki flash flood
items.blurb: An estimated 35 to 40 houses and several bridges have been swept away in Gorkha, while a suspected landslide may have triggered the flooding. Five people have been reported missing as rescue efforts continue.
